## `Core/Graphics/Paint/Painter.h`

- `class [[nodiscard]] PaintScope` — A temporary Painter state (transform, clip, opacity, blend, group, target, marker).
- `struct GroupStyle` — Draws the group into a temporary image first, then composites it in one piece: overlapping parts do not add up (a fading sprite made of several shapes fades as a whole).
- `GroupStyle`: `float opacity = 1.0f`
- `GroupStyle`: `Blend blend = Blend::Normal`
- `GroupStyle`: `float emission = 0.0f` — Extra bloom share of the whole group
- `class Painter` — Records drawing for one frame (or one offscreen surface).
- `Painter`: `explicit Painter(PaintContext& context)`
- `Painter`: `void Rect(const FloatRect& rect, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void RoundRect(const FloatRect& rect, float radius, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void ChamferRect(const FloatRect& rect, float chamfer, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Rectangle with its corners cut off at 45 degrees ('chamfer' along each edge).
- `Painter`: `void Circle(Float2 center, float radius, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void Ellipse(Float2 center, Float2 radii, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void Arc(Float2 center, float radius, float startAngle, float sweep, const LineStyle& style)` — Part of a circle's outline from 'startAngle' over 'sweep' (clockwise when positive), 'style.width' thick.
- `Painter`: `void Line(Float2 from, Float2 to, const LineStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void Polyline(std::span<const Float2> points, const LineStyle& style, bool closed = false)`
- `Painter`: `void Polygon(std::span<const Float2> points, const ShapeStyle& style)` — Simple (non-self-intersecting) polygon: fill (no gradient), stroke and glow are supported.
- `Painter`: `void Triangle(Float2 a, Float2 b, Float2 c, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void Mesh(std::span<const Float2> points, std::span<const Color4> colors, std::span<const std::uint32_t> indices, float emission = 0.0f)` — Triangles ('indices' in threes) with one colour per point, blended across each triangle: soft fields such as light masks.
- `Painter`: `void FillPath(const Path& path, const ShapeStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void StrokePath(const Path& path, const LineStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `void Glow(Float2 center, float radius, const LightStyle& light)` — Soft round light fading from 'center' to 'radius', added on top (follows RenderQuality::glow).
- `Painter`: `void Image(const TextureRef& texture, const FloatRect& dest, const ImageStyle& style = { })`
- `Painter`: `void Image(const Surface& surface, const FloatRect& dest, const ImageStyle& style = { })` — Whole surface into 'dest'; the surface must have been drawn into this frame or earlier.
- `Painter`: `void ImagePolygon(const Surface& surface, std::span<const Float2> points, std::span<const Float2> sources, Color4 tint = { 255, 255, 255, 255 }, float emission = 0.0f)` — Convex polygon showing part of 'surface': 'sources[i]' is where 'points[i]' samples the surface, in its logical units (as ImageStyle::source), so a piece of an image can be warped onto any convex shape (shards, ripples).
- `Painter`: `void NineSlice(const TextureRef& texture, const FloatRect& dest, const NineSliceStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `Float2 Text(std::string_view text, Float2 position, const TextStyle& style)` — 'position' is the top of the first line; horizontally the line's left end, centre or right end (style.align).
- `Painter`: `Float2 Text(const FontFace& font, std::string_view text, Float2 position, const TextStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `Float2 Text(const FontFace& font, const TextBlock& block, Float2 position, const TextStyle& style)` — A block from font.Layout (its size, wrapping and fitting win over 'style'; colour and effects come from it).
- `Painter`: `Float2 TextBox(std::string_view text, const FloatRect& area, const TextStyle& style)` — Text wrapped or fitted to 'area' (style.maxWidth = area width), aligned inside it, starting at its top.
- `Painter`: `Float2 TextBox(const FontFace& font, std::string_view text, const FloatRect& area, const TextStyle& style)`
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] const FontFace& Font() const` — The game's font (GameSettings::font): widgets and text without a font argument use it.
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] bool HasFont() const`
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Transform(const Affine2& transform)` — Following drawing goes through 'transform' (applied before the current one).
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Clip(const FloatRect& rect)` — Following drawing is clipped to 'rect' (current coordinates) intersected with the current clip.
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Opacity(float opacity)` — Multiplies the alpha of following drawing.
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Blending(Blend blend)`
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Group(const GroupStyle& style = { })`
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Target(Surface& surface, std::optional<Color4> clear = Color4 { 0, 0, 0, 0 })` — Following drawing goes into 'surface' (fresh state: no transform, clip or opacity); cleared first unless 'clear' is empty.
- `Painter`: `PaintScope Marker(std::string_view name)` — Names the following GPU work in captures and the profiler.
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] double Time() const` — Presentation clock in seconds (frozen while the editor pauses) and the frame's step.
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] float Delta() const`
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] const RenderQuality& Quality() const`
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] float PixelScale() const` — Device pixels one unit covers under the current transform (for level-of-detail decisions).
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] FloatRect Bounds() const` — Logical rectangle of the current target (the canvas or a surface) in target coordinates.
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] bool Stale(const Surface& surface) const` — True when 'surface' has no up-to-date image for the current resolution and must be drawn again.
- `Painter`: `[[nodiscard]] PostSettings& Post()` — This frame's post-processing (starts as the game's defaults every frame).
- `Painter`: `void Reject(std::string_view message)` — Drawing helpers report invalid arguments the way Painter does: Debug builds throw invalid_argument here; Release builds count it and return, and the helper draws nothing.

## `Core/Graphics/Paint/PaintStyle.h`

- `enum class StrokeAlign { Center, Inside, Outside }` — How a stroke sits on a shape's edge: centred on it, entirely inside, or entirely outside.
- `enum class StrokeCap { Butt, Round, Square }` — Line ends.
- `enum class StrokeJoin { Miter, Bevel, Round }` — Corners of polylines and paths.
- `enum class Blend { Normal, Add, Multiply, Screen }` — Normal: alpha blending; Add: light adds up (glows); Multiply: darkens; Screen: lightens without saturating.
- `struct StrokeStyle`
- `StrokeStyle`: `float width = 0.0f` — 0: no stroke
- `StrokeStyle`: `Color4 color { }`
- `StrokeStyle`: `StrokeAlign align = StrokeAlign::Center`
- `StrokeStyle`: `StrokeJoin join = StrokeJoin::Miter`
- `struct GlowStyle` — Light around a shape: fades from the shape's edge to 'radius' outside it, added on top of what is below.
- `GlowStyle`: `float radius = 0.0f` — 0: no glow
- `GlowStyle`: `Color4 color { }`
- `GlowStyle`: `float strength = 1.0f` — Multiplies the colour's alpha; above 1 brightens the core
- `enum class GradientKind { None, Linear, Radial }`
- `struct Gradient` — Fill gradient.
- `Gradient`: `GradientKind kind = GradientKind::None`
- `Gradient`: `Color4 from { }`
- `Gradient`: `Color4 to { }`
- `Gradient`: `Float2 start { }`
- `Gradient`: `Float2 end { }`
- `Gradient`: `float radius = 0.0f`
- `Gradient`: `[[nodiscard]] static constexpr Gradient Linear(Float2 start, Float2 end, Color4 from, Color4 to)`
- `Gradient`: `[[nodiscard]] static constexpr Gradient Radial(float radius, Color4 from, Color4 to)`
- `Gradient`: `[[nodiscard]] static constexpr Gradient Vertical(float height, Color4 top, Color4 bottom)` — Top to bottom across a shape of the given height.
- `struct ShapeStyle` — Look of a closed shape.
- `ShapeStyle`: `Color4 fill { 0, 0, 0, 0 }` — Alpha 0: no fill (unless a gradient is set)
- `ShapeStyle`: `Gradient gradient { }` — Replaces 'fill' when set
- `ShapeStyle`: `StrokeStyle stroke { }`
- `ShapeStyle`: `GlowStyle glow { }`
- `ShapeStyle`: `float emission = 0.0f` — 0..1: share of this shape that feeds bloom
- `[[nodiscard]] constexpr ShapeStyle Fill(Color4 color, float emission = 0.0f)`
- `[[nodiscard]] constexpr ShapeStyle Outline(float width, Color4 color, StrokeAlign align = StrokeAlign::Center)`
- `struct LineStyle` — Look of an open line (segment, polyline, path stroke).
- `LineStyle`: `float width = 1.0f`
- `LineStyle`: `Color4 color { 255, 255, 255, 255 }`
- `LineStyle`: `StrokeCap cap = StrokeCap::Butt`
- `LineStyle`: `StrokeJoin join = StrokeJoin::Miter`
- `LineStyle`: `float miterLimit = 4.0f` — Miter length / half width beyond which a Miter join is drawn as Bevel
- `LineStyle`: `GlowStyle glow { }` — Segments only
- `LineStyle`: `float emission = 0.0f`
- `struct ImageStyle` — Drawing a texture into 'dest'.
- `ImageStyle`: `FloatRect source { }`
- `ImageStyle`: `float rotation = 0.0f` — Radians, clockwise
- `ImageStyle`: `Color4 tint { 255, 255, 255, 255 }`
- `ImageStyle`: `float emission = 0.0f`

- `NineSliceStyle`: `float right = 0.0f`
- `NineSliceStyle`: `float bottom = 0.0f`

- `NineSliceStyle`: `Color4 tint { 255, 255, 255, 255 }`

## `Core/Graphics/Paint/Path.h`

- `class Path` — A vector outline built from lines and curves, drawn with Painter::FillPath / StrokePath.
- `Path`: `Path& MoveTo(Float2 point)` — Starts a new contour.
- `Path`: `Path& LineTo(Float2 point)` — The following segments continue the current contour (MoveTo is implied at the origin if none started).
- `Path`: `Path& QuadTo(Float2 control, Float2 to)`
- `Path`: `Path& CubicTo(Float2 control1, Float2 control2, Float2 to)`
- `Path`: `Path& ArcTo(Float2 center, float radius, float startAngle, float sweep)` — Circular arc around 'center' from 'startAngle' over 'sweep' radians (clockwise when positive); connects to the current point with a line.
- `Path`: `Path& Close()` — Joins the contour's end to its start.
- `Path`: `Path& AddPolygon(std::span<const Float2> points)` — Closed contours of common shapes.
- `Path`: `Path& AddRegularPolygon(Float2 center, int sides, float radius, float radians)` — Closed regular polygon: 'sides' corners on a circle of 'radius', the first 'radians' clockwise from +x.
- `Path`: `Path& AddCircle(Float2 center, float radius)`
- `Path`: `void Clear()`
- `Path`: `[[nodiscard]] bool Empty() const`
